'''Kayn Somos''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commander]] active during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was particularly infamous for being ruthless in his tactics and particularly vicious, even by stormtrooper standards, let alone stormtrooper commander standards. He also headed the [[Morvogodine stormtrooper training facility|Stormtrooper training facility]] on [[Morvogodine]], which often sent stormtroopers on "peacekeeping" missions as final tests, and, much like its commander, was rather notorious for being very vicious. Owing to his status as a stormtrooper commander, he lived and died for the Empire, and also held command over both regular stormtroopers and [[Heavy Stormtrooper/Legends|Heavy Stormtroopers]]. His brutality also showed with his frequent use of [[firing squad]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
Kayn Somos is a character that was introduced in one of the Villain Packs of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
